# zxmit's sequence (and Lain's): a TCP server under MUX 1, one 1041-byte block from the PC in one
# +IPD, the 4-byte ack sent with an extra CRLF (busy s...), the 2.x AT+CIPSERVER=0,1 (ERROR on 1.7.6)
mask .*(\\x[0-9A-F][0-9A-F].*){8} <romlog>
mask STAIP,"[0-9.]+" STAIP,"<ip>"
mask STAMAC,"[0-9a-f:]+" STAMAC,"<mac>"
wait WIFI GOT IP\r\n 5000
send AT
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send ATE0
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send AT+CIPDINFO=0
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send AT+CIPMUX=1
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send AT+CIPSERVERMAXCONN=1
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send AT+CIPSERVER=1,23460
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send AT+CIFSR
wait \r\nOK\r\n
dial 23460
wait 0,CONNECT\r\n
peer #END-BLOCK#!
wait #END-BLOCK#!
send AT+CIPSEND=0,4
wait >\x20
raw \x01\x00\x11\x04\r\n
wait SEND OK\r\n
peershow
peerclose
wait 0,CLOSED\r\n
send AT+CIPSERVER=0,1
wait \r\nERROR\r\n
send AT+CIPMUX=0
wait \r\nERROR\r\n
send AT+CIPSERVER=0
wait \r\nOK\r\n
send AT+CIPMUX=0
wait \r\nOK\r\n
